I tested an alternative — the South Arcade — and confirmed it works with a rear-projection setup using an 18-meter throw. transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue before we proceed. My review of the artist's executed license — completed after the sponsor artwork was drafted — found that the licensed work may not contain sponsor logos or paid promotional marks. We can acknowledge the sponsor in printed programs, but the projected artwork itself must contain no sponsor branding. The draft package currently includes the presenting sponsor's logo in the projected artwork, so that will need to be revised before I can give rights clearance. I also want to note I haven't yet updated the partnership deck to reflect this restriction.

transcript.text: I need to flag an accessibility issue before we proceed. My walkthrough today confirmed that the west gate has a stair-only approach after dusk, so visitors using wheelchairs or mobility devices must enter through the east gate. The accessible route requires the public entry time to be set exactly at 7:30 PM so that route lighting and attendants are in place. The draft package currently specifies the west gate for visitor admission, which will need to be revised to the east gate, and the entry time must be set to 7:30 PM before I can give accessibility clearance.
